- **TrainAI Overview:** Offers data collection, annotation (labelling), and validation services for AI training data across text, audio, image, video, and multilingual formats ([TrainAI FAQ](https://community.rws.com/community-hub/resources/rws-services-train-ai-others/trainai/w/faq/6806/about-train-ai)).
- **Annotation QA:** Uses a combination of human review (expert manual check), consensus review (multiple annotations compared), and golden datasets (comparison against known answers) to ensure accuracy ([TrainAI FAQ](https://community.rws.com/community-hub/resources/rws-services-train-ai-others/trainai/w/faq/6806/about-train-ai)).
- **Duties / Tasks:** Involves audio/image transcriptions, entity annotations in natural text, data classification, and collecting specific data types like voice assistant commands or bilingual requests ([TrainAI FAQ](https://community.rws.com/community-hub/resources/rws-services-train-ai-others/trainai/w/faq/6806/about-train-ai)).
- **Qualifications / Vetting:** Community members are evaluated via background questionnaires, language proficiency tests, general machine learning tests (evaluating attention to detail and critical thinking), and project-specific tests ([Recruiting Process FAQ](https://community.rws.com/community-hub/resources/rws-services-train-ai-others/trainai/w/faq/6805/recruiting-process)).
- **Local Knowledge / Language Scope:** Involves 400+ language variants across 175+ countries, frequently sourcing datasets from underrepresented languages ([TrainAI FAQ](https://community.rws.com/community-hub/resources/rws-services-train-ai-others/trainai/w/faq/6806/about-train-ai)).
- **Rubric Application:** Unavailable / Not explicitly mentioned in the provided FAQ page.
- **Malayalam Writing:** Unavailable / Not explicitly mentioned in the provided FAQ page.
- **Feedback:** Unavailable as a detailed workflow, though project-specific training rounds and production team guidance are provided during engagements.

**Role:** Generalist - English & Malayalam
**Status:** This listing is no longer accepting applications / Not accepting applications currently ([Explore Page](https://work.mercor.com/explore))
**Compensation:** $15-$20 per hour
**Location & Type:** Global, Remote, Part-time contract work
**Logo Image:** [Logo](https://work.mercor.com/logo.png)

**Duties ("What You'll Do"):**
- **Fact-Checking:** Conduct fact-checking using trusted public sources and external tools.
- **Data Generation:** Generate high-quality human evaluation data by identifying response strengths, areas for improvement, and factual inaccuracies.
- **Response Assessment:** Assess reasoning quality, clarity, tone, and completeness of responses.
- **Model Alignment:** Ensure model responses align with expected conversational behavior and system guidelines.
- **Analysis Language:** Note that the analysis created will be in English, while the competency interview must be taken in Malayalam.

**Qualifications ("Who You Are"):**
- **Education:** Hold a Bachelor's degree.
- **Language Skills:** Native speaker in Malayalam and strong proficiency/excellent writing skills in English.
- **LLM Experience:** Significant experience using large language models (LLMs) and understanding how and why people use them.
- **Attention to Detail:** Strong attention to detail, consistently noticing subtle issues others may overlook.
- **Analytical Background:** Background or experience in domains requiring structured analytical thinking (e.g., research, policy, analytics, linguistics, engineering).

**Nice-to-Have Specialties:**
- **Annotation & Evaluation:** Prior experience with RLHF, model evaluation, or data annotation work.
- **Content Creation:** Experience writing or editing high-quality written content.
- **Comparative Judgment:** Experience comparing multiple outputs and making fine-grained qualitative judgments.

**Contract and Payment Terms:**
- **Engagement:** Independent contractor, fully remote on your own schedule.
- **Payment:** Weekly on Stripe or Wise based on services rendered.
- **Referral Policy:** Earn up to $180 per referral; details available in the [Referral Policy](https://talent.docs.mercor.com/policies/referrals).
